svg.title: WaterNet synthetic image preprocessing pipeline – horizontal layout
svg.desc: Left-to-right pipeline: 3D noise generators → texture filters → light and camera angle, branching into a standard-image path (1D cartesian motion blur) and a YAW motion blur path (2D cartesian motion blur), converging at Gaussian blur → V channel isolation → CNN model.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What are the 3D noise generators used in the WaterNet synthetic data pipeline?')
sendPrompt('What texture filters are applied during WaterNet synthetic image generation?')
sendPrompt('How does light and camera angle conditioning work in the WaterNet Blender pipeline?')
sendPrompt('What are standard images in the WaterNet pipeline and how do they differ from the YAW branch?')
sendPrompt('What is YAW motion blur and when is it applied in the WaterNet synthetic pipeline?')
sendPrompt('How is 1D Cartesian motion blur applied in WaterNet image synthesis?')
sendPrompt('How is 2D Cartesian motion blur applied in WaterNet image synthesis?')
sendPrompt('What role does Gaussian blur play in WaterNet preprocessing before V channel extraction?')
sendPrompt('Why is the HSV V channel isolated instead of grayscale in WaterNet?')
sendPrompt('What CNN architectures are used in WaterNet for altitude regression?')
